# AI Bots Creative Studio — Full Technical Reference & Tool Directory

> AI Bots Creative Studio (https://www.aibots.co.in) is a privacy-first, zero-server-upload suite of 33+ browser-based creative, financial, productivity, and gaming tools engineered by Rishit Chajjed. All operations execute locally in the client browser using WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, Web Audio API, and local storage.

---

## 1. Financial & Business Tools

### Cash & Udhar Ledger
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/ledger.html
- **Description**: All-in-one personal cash passbook, Udhar khata (debt/credit tracker), daily expense tracker, and split-bill manager.
- **Key Features**: Auto-calculating running balances, customer passbooks, WhatsApp statement export, PDF export, zero server sync (100% offline via localStorage).
- **Use Cases**: Shopkeeper khata book, roommate expense splitting, personal cash budgeting.

### Bank Statement to Tally XML Converter
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/bank-statement-converter.html
- **Description**: Convert PDF/CSV bank statements into TallyPrime / Tally.ERP 9 XML vouchers with 0.00 difference reconciliation.
- **Supported Banks**: 21+ major Indian banks (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, PNB, Bank of Baroda, Canara, Kotak, Union, IndusInd, and more).
- **Privacy**: Local PDF parsing via pdf.js; sensitive financial data never leaves your device.

### Professional GST / VAT Invoice Maker
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/invoice.html
- **Description**: Create professional tax invoices with auto CGST/SGST/IGST calculation, UPI payment QR codes, itemized lines, discounts, and high-res PDF generation.
- **Export Options**: Instant print and clean vector PDF download.

### Business Card Studio
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/buisnesscard.html
- **Description**: Design modern, double-sided printable business cards with custom typography, vCard QR codes, 12 luxury themes, and 8-card A4 print sheets with crop marks.

### Pro Print Studio (Ultra-HD)
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/print.html
- **Description**: Document scaling, DPI tuning, multi-page layout grid, watermark stamping, and borderless print presets.

### Live Currency Converter
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/currency.html
- **Description**: Real-time foreign exchange rates for 160+ world currencies with historic trend analysis.

---

## 2. Media & Creative Studio

### Voice Recorder & Audio Studio Pro
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/audiorecorder.html
- **Description**: High-fidelity browser voice recorder featuring real-time waveform visualizer, 300% volume booster, playback speed controls, and high-quality WAV/WebM audio export.
- **Key Features**: Web Audio API visualizer, pause/resume recording, client-side WAV encoding, 100% private with zero file uploads.

### Video Studio Pro (NLE Editor & Trimmer)
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/videoeditor.html
- **Description**: High-speed, lossless browser video trimmer, cutter, audio extractor, speed changer, and compressor.
- **Features**: Multi-clip timeline, split, duplicate, transitions, audio ducking, LUT filters, captions, and export presets for Reels/Shorts/TikTok (9:16) and YouTube (16:9).

### Cyber Cinema HD Video Player
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/videoplayer.html
- **Description**: Feature-rich local video player featuring 300% audio volume boost, frame grabber (4K screenshot extraction), A-B loop repeater, and playback speed 0.25x-4x.

### AI Background Remover
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/backremover.html
- **Description**: 1-click photo background eraser powered by client-side edge detection algorithms and transparent PNG export.

### Precision Photo Crop
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/cropphoto.html
- **Description**: 8-handle precision rule-of-thirds photo cropper with standard aspect ratios (1:1, 16:9, 4:3, circular, passport sizes).

### Multi-Format Image Resizer
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/resizeimage.html
- **Description**: Resize photos by exact pixel dimensions, percentage, or specific file target sizes (KB/MB) for government forms and exams.

### Image Merger & Stitcher
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/imagecombiner.html
- **Description**: Combine multiple images vertically, horizontally, or in grid collages with custom border spacing.

### Vector Logo Maker
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/logomaker.html
- **Description**: Create vector logos, badges, and typography with instant PNG/SVG vector download.

### Image to PDF Maker
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/pdfmaker.html
- **Description**: Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images into unified multi-page PDF documents.

### Fast PDF Reader & Viewer
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/pdfviewer.html
- **Description**: In-browser PDF reader with thumbnails, text search, rotation, and presentation mode.

## 3. Utilities & AI Assistant

### JSON Formatter, Validator & Converter Studio
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/jsonformatter.html
- **Description**: Client-side JSON formatter, validator, tree inspector, and converter (JSON ↔ CSV, XML, YAML) with syntax auto-repair and sample datasets.
- **Key Features**: 2/4 spaces, minifier, interactive collapsible tree view, CSV table export, XML/YAML translation, zero server communication.

### Smart Emoji Studio (1,120+)
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/emojis.html
- **Description**: Search 1,120+ Unicode emojis with category filtering, skin tone selector, and 1-click clipboard copy.

### AI Assistant (Gemini)
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/chatbot.html
- **Description**: Interactive AI assistant powered by Gemini for coding questions, drafting, and technical help.

### Custom QR Code Studio
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/qrcode.html
- **Description**: High-resolution QR code generator supporting URLs, Wi-Fi configuration, vCards, emails, and UPI payment strings.

### Secure Password Generator
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/password.html
- **Description**: Cryptographically strong password generator utilizing `crypto.getRandomValues()` with entropy strength scoring.

### Universal Unit Converter
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/unitconverter.html
- **Description**: Instant conversion for Length, Weight, Temperature, Digital Storage, Speed, Pressure, and Energy.

### Smart Word & Text Counter
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/wordcounter.html
- **Description**: Real-time counter for words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading time, and keyword density.

### Live Weather Radar
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/weather.html
- **Description**: Global weather conditions, temperature, humidity, wind velocity, UV index, and multi-day forecasts.

### Precision Stopwatch & Timer
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/timer.html
- **Description**: Millisecond-accurate stopwatch with lap recording and Pomodoro productivity countdown timer.

### Scientific & Standard Calculator
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/calculator.html
- **Description**: Calculator with trigonometry (sin, cos, tan), DEG/RAD modes, logarithm functions, and calculation history.

### File Extension Changer
- **URL**: https://www.aibots.co.in/endchanger.html
- **Description**: Rename and convert file extensions safely inside the browser.
